name: BUBBLE RUSH
title: Bubble Rush
blurb: Pop the rising bubbles before anyone else. Free-for-all or teams.
description: Bubbles rise and wobble; tap to pop them. Small ones score most, golden ones are a bonus, and bombs cost points and stun you. Chain pops for up to ×5, and a miss breaks the streak. Free-for-all or teams, against friends or bots.
author: lokeshmohanty
